**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 31 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 29 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 26 [Shrine Maiden](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2788) **Source** [Pathfinder #198: No Breath to Cry](/Sources.aspx?ID=224) pg. 50 **Perception** +20 **Languages** [Celestial](/Languages.aspx?ID=16), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1) **Skills** [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +16, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +17, [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) +18, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +19 **Str** +1 **Dex** +3 **Con** +1 **Int** +2 **Wis** +4 **Cha** +3 **Items** [+1 leather armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=4), [Holy Water](/Equipment.aspx?ID=245) (3), key ring (includes a key that opens all gates except Earth gate, the key to Earth gate, and a key that unlocks all interior doors except those leading into Mago Kai's quarters and the treasury), [Light Mace](/Weapons.aspx?ID=5), _+1 striking [composite shortbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=435)_ (20 arrows) --- **AC** 27 **Fort** +14 **Ref** +18 **Will** +19 **HP** 152 --- **Speed** 25 feet **Melee** light mace +18, **Damage** 1d4+5 bludgeoning **Ranged** composite shortbow +19 ([deadly d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=191), [range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248)), **Damage** 2d6+5 piercing **Divine Spontaneous Spells** DC 25, attack +17 - **Cantrips (5th)** [Chill Touch](/Spells.aspx?ID=35), [Disrupt Undead](/Spells.aspx?ID=79), [Divine Lance](/Spells.aspx?ID=84), [Forbidding Ward](/Spells.aspx?ID=126), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280), [Stabilize](/Spells.aspx?ID=307) - **1st** [Bless](/Spells.aspx?ID=25), [Purify Food and Drink](/Spells.aspx?ID=241), [Sanctuary](/Spells.aspx?ID=266) (3 slots) - **2nd** [Augury](/Spells.aspx?ID=15), [Remove Fear](/Spells.aspx?ID=252), [See Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=271) (3 slots) - **3rd** [Dispel Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Searing Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=269) (3 slots) - **4th** [Dimensional Anchor](/Spells.aspx?ID=70), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Holy Cascade](/Spells.aspx?ID=151) (3 slots) - **5th** [Divine Wrath](/Spells.aspx?ID=86), [Sending](/Spells.aspx?ID=272) (2 slots) **Rituals** - **2nd** [Consecrate](/Rituals.aspx?ID=8) **Spiritual Arrows** ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The shrine maiden nocks an arrow and whispers a chant before unleashing a torrent of holy power in the form of dozens of ghostly glowing arrows. Creatures in a 60-foot line take 10d6 force damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save). On a critical failure, the creature is also immobilized ([Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) DC 28) for 1 minute. **Twang** ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [Manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104), [Sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=147)) The shrine maiden strums her bowstring, creating a pulse of energy that lashes out at a target within 20 feet. That creature must attempt a DC 28 Fortitude save. **Critical Success** No Effect
**Success** The target is pushed 5 feet back from the shrine maiden.
**Failure** The target is pushed 10 feet back from the shrine maiden and falls [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88).
**Critical Failure** The target is flung 15 feet away from the shrine maiden, falls prone, and is [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) 1 for 1 round.
